summary: Master data management and analysis with our Stata course. Gain hands-on experience in creating impactful visualizations and insights from your data.
lede: Stata analysis training connects data preparation, statistical analysis, and reporting in reproducible workflows. It is for analysts and other professionals who prepare, model, or communicate structured datasets. Participants practise checking data quality, integrating and reshaping files, interpreting descriptive and regression results, and creating clear graphs and reports with documented do-files.
audienceIntro: This Stata training is for professionals who regularly prepare, analyse, model, or communicate structured datasets and want a more reliable end-to-end workflow.
prerequisites: You should have working experience with spreadsheets or structured datasets and basic familiarity with descriptive statistics. No programming background is required, but you should be comfortable reading variables, filters, tables, and numerical summaries. You will use Stata syntax throughout the practical work, while advanced topics such as panel-data modelling and AI-assisted code review remain at operational application or guided-practice level rather than technical engineering level. A laptop with Stata installed is recommended for hands-on completion.
